task: Starting from GEOM-C3 SMILES, orchestrate RDKit, xTB/CREST, ORCA, and GoodVibes to reconstruct the major conformer basins and test whether low-cost ranking agrees with the quantum free-energy ranking. Recover the paper conclusion that low-cost search provides coverage but quantum refinement can change the dominant conformer and populations.
scientific_mode_description: A scoped part of a published research workflow is supplied. The agent must orchestrate multiple chemistry programs, validate intermediate artifacts, and recover the paper conclusion from newly generated evidence.
scientific_requirements: Run at least four distinct software stages from the supplied DAG.
Preserve atom mapping and conformer lineage across every stage.
Compare aligned rankings; do not compare unrelated file-order indices.
Report how refinement-budget truncation affects the conclusion.

required_deliverables.description: Initial hypotheses, software DAG, budgets, gates, and stopping rules.
One provenance record for every chemistry-software invocation.
Failed, rejected, retried, or inconclusive branches.
Counts and failures by software stage.
Atom-mapped lineage from RDKit through quantum refinement.
Aligned xTB, electronic-energy, and free-energy rankings.
Final relative free energies, weights, and population coverage.
Artifact-linked paper-reproduction report and uncertainty analysis.

data.name: Guided multi-software reproduction inputs
data.description: Visible structures, protocol, workflow gates, and manifests. No paper result values or completed quantum-chemistry outputs are included.
